primary_sources: Harvard College Guide to Creating a Strong Resume

rules.explanation: For current students and recent graduates, Education should be placed near the top right after Contact Information. For experienced professionals (2+ years), Work Experience takes top priority.
rules.do: Place Education above Work Experience if you are a student/recent graduate, or below Experience if you have established career history.
rules.dont: Do not push Education to the bottom if you are a student or fresh graduate.

rules.explanation: All entries within Education, Work Experience, Projects, and Leadership must strictly follow reverse chronological order (most recent first).
rules.do: List your current or most recent degree, job, or project at the top of its respective section.
rules.dont: Do not mix dates out of sequence or list older experiences before current ones.

rules.explanation: The header must contain essential professional contact channels only. Unnecessary personal attributes reduce scannability and introduce compliance risks.
rules.do: Include full name, professional email, phone number, location (City, Country/State), and LinkedIn/GitHub links.
rules.dont: Do not include photos, age, gender, full home address, or personal status.

rules.explanation: A clean skills section clusters related proficiencies into labeled categories, improving human scannability and ATS keyword parsing.
rules.dont: Do not dump an unstructured comma-separated block of 30+ mixed skills.
